note: hue=s=0 is a true greyscale conversion - measured SATAVG exactly 0.000, so this is the one look in the set that cannot interact badly with the colour of the fx layer, because there is nothing left to tint. That makes the otherwise steep contrast of 1.32 safe here in a way it would not be on a colour look. Mild unsharp for the hard-edged period feel.
